note: Tank ramming (src/tank_ram.cpp, docs/tanks.md#ramming). An obstacle gives way once the energy put into it reaches breakKJ: the tank brings 1/2 M v^2 on contact and its engine adds engineKW x pushEfficiency x throttle per second while it pushes. massKg: what the knocked-over prop takes with it (momentum). mode: topple (falls as a rigid body), rubble (collapses into a low heap), block (never gives way).
wallNote: building walls: breakKJ = kJ per cm of the wall thickness for its family, shared by the whole face (piers, bays, lintels); concrete (bunkers) never gives way
